name: False Preachers
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false preachers who appear harmless but are inwardly destructive, likened to wolves in sheep's clothing. Not all who profess faith or call Jesus 'Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven; entrance depends on doing the will of the Father. Furthermore, false Christs and prophets will perform impressive signs and wonders with the intent to deceive, even targeting the most discerning believers.
